rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in NAC 690A.125(2), by term of loan in months (bands 1 to 12 through 169 to 180) and prospective (14- or 30-day) or retroactive (7-, 14- or 30-day) benefits; the 1 to 12 and 49 to 60 month bands are recorded. A monthly outstanding balance table per $1,000 by term is in 690A.125(3) (for example 1.48 and 0.85 prospective, 1 to 12 months); not recorded. Joint is 1.85 times single (10). Rates may be increased 1.8 percent with the age limits in 690A.135(5).
source_title: NAC chapter 690A, Credit Insurance (Nevada Legislature; sections added by R014-06, eff. 4-1-2007; amended by R145-08, eff. 9-18-2008)
summary: Rates in force: Nevada's prima facie single premium credit accident and health rates in NAC 690A.125(2), per $100 of initial insured debt, for loan terms of 1 to 12 and 49 to 60 months. The section was last amended by R145-08, effective September 18, 2008; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked, so September 18, 2008 is the date the current text took effect.
